contentText:
The only noticable difference is that the camera oval is shorter. | Image: Android Headlines

Google isn't making any significant design changes to its upcoming midrange Pixel update, judging by the leaks shared by Android Headlines . The image renders made by OnLeaks are potentially our first look at the Pixel 11A, which aside from having a slightly rounder oval-shaped rear camera module, looks almost indistinguishable from both the Pixel 10A and Pixel 9A .

It seems the chunky display bezels sported by those predecessors will also carry over as they're present in these leaked images. It makes the phone look very dated compared to the wider Pixel 11 series lineup, but a previous report from Mystic Leaks suggests the Pixel 11A will at …

Read the full story at The Verge.
